summary: Both archive and unarchive paths (project chat + Quick Chat) assert identity via ID-keyed lookup, positive+negative container-membership checks (project.sessions vs standaloneSessions vs archivedChats/pinnedSessions), and equality of filePath, cachedTranscript, and isPinned against captured pre-mutation values, using the real AppModel with no mocking; would fail on regressions that drop fields, reassign IDs, or misplace sessions across containers.
